profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at LinkedIn
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I am a backend software engineer with over 8 years of experience in building large scale systems across a variety of technologies. My current role is in backend API development (primarily in Java and Python) with a recent focus on search & relevance systems & incorporating Gen-AI into the LinkedIn Search platform. I have deep experience with distributed big data technologies such as Hadoop,
Hive, and Spark, microservices architectures, and orchestration systems like OpenConnect and Airflow. 

I am passionate about driving business impact through technology and have experience leading, designing, and building org-wide tech products and executing projects across teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked across a variety of projects driving relevance evaluation of LinkedIn’s semantic retrieval and ranking in Recruiter Search and Hiring Assistant. Implemented new system to deliver near realtime relevance metrics for search results, leveraging a teacher LLM model and extensive data pipelines.

Implemented a system for offline end to end evaluation leveraging batch query replay and LLM as judge to assess relevance of semantic search results, adopted to test changes prior to rolling out in production.

Developed new set of product features to improve online recommendation system for recruiters. This incorporated several strategies including new activity-based recommendations blending offline and near-realtime activity indexes and several caching layers into a new product feature. Led significant database and caching redesign and implementation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Engineer for Bloomberg Engineering's CI/CD platform, a distributed, event-driven system used daily by ~7k+ engineers, composed of Java and Python services integrated with open-source and industry standard tools as well as proprietary testing, build, packaging, and deployment systems.

Architected and developed various RESTful APIs for features on the client-facing Java web service where developers can configure CI/CD

Re-designed and implemented real-time load-balancing and management of events across our system and several Jenkins instances.

Implemented batch offline task for reducing excess load, resulting in 20% load reduction across our systems

Technologies used: Python (Django, Flask, FastAPI), Java, Postgres, Kafka, Docker & docker-compose, Github, Jenkins, j-Frog Artifactory, S3, Kubernetes-based PaaS for containerized microservice deployment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed the infrastructure and pipelines to provide a scalable platform for onboarding providers onto Bloomberg’s Alternative Data platform, leveraging a microservices architecture, front-end development, and a variety of data storage systems. Collaborated with business and product teams as well as external clients to prioritize development focus.

Developer for BI data warehouse, responsibilities include developing and implementing Spark ETL jobs for various data sources in a distributed environment and exposing data to business and product users via Hive and BI visualization tools. Technologies leveraged include PySpark, Hive, Hadoop, Oozie, and Postgres.

positions.title: Economics/Commodities Data Analyst
positions.description: Facilitate the migration of numerous economic datasets to open-source software through collaboration with various Bloomberg teams including Engineering, Data, and Business. Worked closely with sales and business product managers to strategically prioritize and develop new value-add datasets. Developed and implemented automated processes to reduce maintenance costs and address data processing inefficiencies.
